description: VerifyLingua Document Translation Service Golden Test Corpus

corpus.description: Two-column academic PDF with sidebar and footnotes
corpus.expected_behavior: Correct multi-column reading order and footnote preservation

corpus.description: 20-page contract with repeated defined terms (Board, Agreement)
corpus.expected_behavior: Terminology consistency across 20 pages without drift

corpus.description: Table-heavy multi-page financial statement with numbers and merged cells
corpus.expected_behavior: Accurate table column alignment and numerical preservation

corpus.description: Scanned certificate simulation (300 DPI layout)
corpus.expected_behavior: Clean text layer recovery and visual inpainting

corpus.description: Mobile phone photo of civil registry record with perspective lighting
corpus.expected_behavior: Robust OCR without geometric hallucination

corpus.description: Photo with EXIF orientation tag 6 (90 deg CW)
corpus.expected_behavior: Orientation normalized upright and EXIF metadata stripped

corpus.description: 4-page hybrid PDF (digital, scanned, hybrid, vector graphic)
corpus.expected_behavior: Per-page classification (digital, scanned, hybrid, vector) 100% accurate

corpus.description: PDF with broken CID font encoding
corpus.expected_behavior: Detects low text layer trustworthiness and routes to visual OCR

corpus.description: User password encrypted PDF (userpass123)
corpus.expected_behavior: Pauses in needs_password state with E_PDF_PASSWORD, unlocks on correct password

corpus.description: Owner-restricted PDF (no user password required to view, text extraction restricted)
corpus.expected_behavior: Identifies owner restriction and requests confirmation before proceeding

corpus.description: Truncated PDF with damaged xref table
corpus.expected_behavior: Attempts repair or halts safely with E_PDF_CORRUPT
corpus.gate_target: E_PDF_CORRUPT or qpdf repair handled cleanly

corpus.description: PDF containing embedded /JavaScript and /OpenAction payloads
corpus.expected_behavior: Sanitizes active scripts before processing without worker exploit

corpus.description: DOCX zip bomb with > 10,000 entries
corpus.expected_behavior: Rejected by intake S1 with E_DOCX_SECURITY_RISK

corpus.description: PNG image with 900 MP header (decompression bomb defense)
corpus.expected_behavior: Rejected by intake before memory allocation with E_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE

corpus.description: DOCX package containing XXE external entity injection
corpus.expected_behavior: Blocked by defusedxml parser with E_DOCX_SECURITY_RISK

corpus.description: Complex DOCX with headers, footers, tables, and bold/italic runs
corpus.expected_behavior: Run-level XML text replacement preserving all container structures

corpus.description: Arabic RTL document with embedded English names, dates, numbers, and emails
corpus.expected_behavior: HarfBuzz shaping + BiDi isolate token protection

corpus.description: Dense marketing flyer with multi-styled headings and background layout
corpus.expected_behavior: Auto-fit font reduction to avoid boundary overflow

corpus.description: 100-page document load test
corpus.expected_behavior: Completes without memory OOM, streaming page by page

corpus.description: 101-page document exceeding the 100-page cap
corpus.expected_behavior: Rejected at intake S1 with E_PAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED

corpus.description: Real-world test file from user (DocuMatch Spanish civil certificate photo)
corpus.expected_behavior: Golden test case: full layout-preserving translation into AR, FR, EN
